informations.title: Creative leisure workshops at home in Montpellier and its surroundings - adults and children
description: Welcome to my site for a creative and festive break!

My name is Valérie, and for 20 years I have been organizing and leading creative leisure workshops for children, teenagers, and adults, at home, in schools, at your workplace, in companies, in associations and community centers, in the Montpellier (34), Puylaurens (81), and Le Cailar (30) regions and their surroundings.
I offer you my skills, good humor, enthusiasm, and experience for original activities at home!
Are you looking for an activity for:
<tr>a children's birthday party,</tr>
<tr>an adult/child activity during school holidays,</tr>
<tr>a bachelorette party,</tr>
<tr>an animation in a store or café,</tr>
<tr>a workshop at your place, creating Christmas, Easter, or spring decorations,</tr>
<tr>an animation in a club (retirement home, association...),</tr>
<tr>an animation in schools (schools, colleges, youth centers, companies, hospitals...).</tr>
I am here to help, so choose your activity, and I will take care of the rest!
My workshops last an average of 2 hours and must take place indoors (or in the garden in summer) with a table and chair for each participant.

Home travel is available for a minimum of 5 participants for children's workshops and 4 participants for adult workshops, with a maximum of 10 people (within a 30km radius of Montpellier, Nîmes, or Castres).
Workshops are available from Monday to Sunday.
They are open to adults and children from 5 years old.
For children under 5, a personalized quote can be made. I will need you to provide the age of the participants and indicate if they are used to creating with their hands.

A travel fee will be charged in addition to the activity price (€15 from Monday to Saturday / €20 on Sundays and public holidays). However, if you live more than 30km from Montpellier, I can also travel, and I will recalculate the travel fee. In Castres and Le Cailar, the base fee remains valid.
Also, you can sponsor friends: 1 sponsorship with a dated workshop = a 10% discount on a future workshop.
A 30% deposit will be required upon booking: payment either by bank transfer or PayPal.
IMPORTANT information!!! To allow me to unpack the necessary materials for the workshop, I need a guaranteed parking space nearby.

informations.title: Think about sponsoring your friends because gifts await you!
Why develop creativity?
description: Creativity promotes individual development in several ways:

<tr>First of all, let's be clear, creating while having fun or having fun while creating is good for morale, it feels good, it helps to ease daily tensions, and it allows for a little zen break! But if we go a little further, we realize that creating is deeper than that:</tr>
<tr>Identity: creativity allows the child to strengthen their identity when they show originality in their games or daily life.</tr>
<tr>Openness: creativity teaches the child to perceive things from different angles and thus promotes their openness to others and their environment.</tr>
<tr>Self-esteem: for adults or children, creating has effects on self-esteem when engaging in playful or artistic activities.</tr>
<tr>Expression: it facilitates the expression of emotions and ideas, and it also allows the shyest to express themselves.</tr>
<tr>Concentration: it contributes to the development of concentration, self-discipline, and critical thinking.</tr>
In short, it's excellent for health!!! ;-) Whether you're big or small!

informations.title: Workshops in Fabrègues (adults, children, or mixed)
description: Here are a few examples of previous workshops.
<tr>Price: €35/child for 3 hours of activities (complimentary homemade snack included)</tr>

informations.title: Children's workshops
description: And here are examples of creations made by students (ages 4 to 12) during previous workshops, including pottery, jewelry, and visual arts:

informations.title: Heart decoration workshop
description: A stunning large wall decoration (for kitchen, bedroom, etc.) with a 29cm wingspan. Lightweight wooden piece.
Keep it for yourself or give it as a gift to Mom, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa...
Using a wooden base, we will learn how to paint beautiful gradients with a sponge, then do lettering work with a special molding paste, and finally, create moldings with self-hardening clay.
Of course, as in all of our workshops, colors and decorations are unlimited and tailored to each person's taste, guaranteeing a unique, creative piece.
I provide: the base, paints, modeling clay, molds, self-hardening clay, and any decorations like rhinestones and flowers.
<tr>Price: €25/person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: UV resin initial keychain
description: This activity is recommended for ages 7 and up.
It is suitable for both girls and boys.
Each student will use a silicone mold of their initial to create their own personalized keychain using the UV resin technique.
Colors and decorations will be up to each individual.
The initial will then be mounted on a chain and keychain clasp, complete with a ribbon and a tassel.
Jewelry-making precision is key for this activity.
Allow about 1 hour and 30 minutes for crafting.
<tr>Price: €18/child.</tr>

informations.title: Botanical frame (all seasons)
description: This activity is available for ages 6 and up.
However, if your child and their friends are creative and dexterous, this activity can be offered from age 5.

Each child will create their own botanical garden using supplies adapted to the season (or at your convenience): moss, wood, flowers, pumpkins, mushrooms, various faux plants, and ceramics handcrafted by myself...
The wooden frame measures 12cm on each side.
<tr>Price: €20/child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

menu_title: Travel journal or photo album (art journal)

informations.title: Art journal: travel/photo journal, recipe book, match scorebook...
description: This activity is perfect for both girls and boys! I recommend it for ages 5 and up.
What will we be doing, and what can this journal be used for?
We will only decorate the front cover (allow about 2 hours of work), and each child will choose the main color and theme for their journal. This involves gluing and painting.
Children can use it as a photo album, a recipe or poetry book, an herbarium... They can track their match scores, sports rankings, or write down friends' phone numbers and addresses...
Rest assured, every child will find a personal use for it!
Here are photos of some creations made by children aged 5 to 12.
I provide: the journal, all decorations (vintage and new papers, tassels, flowers, insects, rhinestones...), paints, and glue.
<tr>Price: €24/child (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: Decorated secret diary workshop
description: This activity is perfect for both girls and boys! I recommend it for ages 4 and up.
What can this diary be used for?
A 20cm tall Bristol-type notebook that can serve as a secret diary, a game scorebook, a notepad, a poetry book, a sketchbook, an herbarium...
Rest assured, every child will find a personal use for it!
The listed price applies from Monday to Saturday. A 10% extra charge applies on Sundays and public holidays.
I provide: the notebook, fabrics, various decorations (handmade ceramic mosaics, flowers, glass, wood, etc.), as well as 3D relief paints to add the finishing touch to the creation.
I do not provide the pen shown in the photos.
Everyone will find decorations to match their taste and style (decorations are unlimited!).
<tr>Price: €12/child.</tr>

informations.title: Bracelet/earrings workshop (Christmas or other themes)
description: This workshop is available for children aged 9 and up. It requires a bit of dexterity.
Students will have a wide choice of charms (highly diverse and excellent quality) and can create either:
- A bracelet with matching earrings,
- Or a necklace with matching earrings.
Not around Christmas time? No problem! ;-) The same style of jewelry is possible with other themes! I have beautiful, high-quality charms to choose from.
<tr>Price: €13/person.</tr>

informations.title: Bag charm / keychain workshop
description: A keychain (for boys)... A bag charm (for girls)... This is a co-ed activity and I recommend it for ages 6 and up.
My professional tools and materials will be available to the children. A wide variety of high-quality supplies.
Each piece of jewelry is unique; the photos displayed on this site are only meant to give you an idea of what can be created.
A professional result guaranteed!
I provide: cotton and steel wire, a wide variety of beads, ribbons and charms, handmade ceramic beads, yarn for tassels if you choose keychain version 2, rhinestones, glitter, snap hooks, etc.
<tr>Price: €14/person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>

informations.title: Treasure hunt and Finnish skittles (for 10+ children):
description: This activity is exclusively for groups of more than 10 children.
A treasure hunt featuring multiple activities: sports, culture, quizzes, motor skills...
Followed by a group game of Finnish skittles (Mölkky)!
Fun and entertainment guaranteed!!!
<tr>Price: €14/person.</tr>

informations.title: Suncatcher
description: Both a decoration and a source of energy and vibrations, the suncatcher workshop allows you to create an object that reflects your style while learning jewelry assembly techniques.
All materials are provided and come in many different shapes.
Gold or silver metal, iridescent glass pieces, chains, hooks, butterflies, moons, lotuses, teardrops, suns...
This workshop can be offered from age 10 and up. Ideal as a parent/child workshop.
<tr>Price: €30/person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Decorated bottle: 2 sessions are required!
description: The art of recycling, upcycling, and beautifying an ordinary bottle.
Techniques used: painting, modeling paste, image collage, texture paste, and various small decorations.
This workshop must be taken over two 3-hour sessions, depending on the size of the chosen bottle.
I can provide the bottle, but you can also bring your own if it has an original shape.
This workshop is open to ages 14 and up.
All materials are provided.
<tr>Price: €35 / person x 2, making it €70 to have a completely finished piece (this means 2 sessions to be scheduled).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: 3D Relief painting & sculpture: modeling paste
description: Whether you are a novice or experienced, this activity will inspire you for future creations!
We will work on a small 12cm square canvas.
Techniques used: acrylic paint, stencils, palette knife work, modeling paste...
The photos visible here are examples of possible designs. However, each student will work in their own style.
Poppy or magnolia will be the 2 flower models offered.
Paints, stencils, canvas, modeling paste, and all necessary equipment: open bar and unlimited use.
This workshop lasts an average of 3 hours.
<tr>Price: €40.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Retro mixed media canvas workshop
description: 2 sessions are required!
A wonderful workshop to do with friends, groups, or associations...
Like all my workshops, all materials are included and unlimited: images, vintage jewelry, fabrics, lace, rhinestones, gold leaf, artificial flowers, etc.
However, you can also bring personal items to create a piece that truly reflects you (a family heirloom, a wedding veil, a specific image).
Family photo? Pet photo? Feel free to bring it. Otherwise, images will be provided for you.
Two sessions will be necessary to leave with a (nearly) completely finished creation :-)
<tr>Price: €40 / person x 2, making it €80 in total (This means 2 sessions to be scheduled).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Adult UV resin
description: I invite you to come and create your very own UV resin jewelry.
YOUR CHOICE: a pair of earrings OR a necklace (pendant + chain).
A 1.5-hour activity where you will learn the technique and incorporate your own inclusions: dried flowers, paper flowers, gold and silver leaf, glass micro-beads, etc.
A pendant or earrings to match your taste and style, and a great time spent with friends!
All materials are provided.
<tr>Price: €30 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Painted flower pot
description: Flower pot painting using several techniques.
Professional results!
Pot is approximately 15cm tall.
Multiple decoration options available, based on the student's preference.
The process is made easy thanks to my technique, which is open to both pros and beginners ;-)
Expect about 3 hours of work.
<tr>Price: €30 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Scallop shell trinket dish
description: In this workshop, I invite you to decorate a large scallop shell, approximately 10 to 12cm wide.
You can select your artwork from several design options across all styles.
To seal and gloss your work, I will teach you the UV resin technique.
Then, we will decorate as much as you like.
The shell sits on a brass tripod stand, which is included in the workshop price.
All materials are included.
<tr>Price: €25 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Art journal: travel/emotion/photo/recipe/notebook...
description: This activity is suitable for both adults and children. It is therefore possible to run an intergenerational workshop!
What is the actual process and what will this journal be used for?
We will only decorate the front cover (allow about 2 hours of work) and each student will decide on the main color and theme of their notebook. This involves collage and painting.
This journal can be used for many occasions: photo album, recipe or poetry book, emotion journal, herbarium...
All materials are included: 20cm x 20cm notebook, papers, paints, stencils, small decorations such as rhinestones, ribbons, and lace...
Here are a few photos of example creations.
<tr>Price: €30 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Tile painting
description: This workshop has a very Provençal feel! Teenagers and adults alike will love it!
No need to be an experienced painter to join in, I have plenty of simple techniques to help you reach a perfect result.
An authentic roof tile, it will serve as an indoor or outdoor decoration.
Several templates are provided to help you create something you'll love and surprise yourself with.
This workshop lasts an average of 3 hours.
I provide: 1 large tile per student + all painting materials.
<tr>Price: €50 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

informations.title: Adult canvas painting
description: This workshop is open to adults and teenagers.
Expect about 3 hours of work.
Canvas and paints are provided, including small elements to glue on such as sequins, glitter, or other embellishments for those who want them.
Several models will be available to help students find inspiration more easily.
<tr>Price: €50 / person (10% extra on Sundays and public holidays).</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people, maximum 6</tr>

informations.title: Jewelry workshop for adults
description: I invite you to create the jewelry of your dreams! The kind you will never find in stores!
Necklace, brooch, ring, bracelet, earrings...
Thousands of beads, tassels, feathers, backings, chains, and hooks will be available for you to use.
I will be there to guide you step-by-step, whether you are a beginner or experienced.
All styles and colors are welcome, whether you like simple, understated jewelry... or oversized XXL pieces...
At the end of the workshop, which lasts about 2.5 hours on average, you will be able to wear a unique piece of jewelry that you will be happy and proud to show off.
All materials are provided. Each student will leave with a matching set: necklace/ring OR necklace/earrings OR bracelet/ring OR bracelet/earrings... brooch/ring OR brooch/earrings.
Custom requests are also welcome.
<tr>Price: €40 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people, maximum 10</tr>

informations.title: Sacred heart in air-dry clay
description: Coming soon...
This workshop will soon be offered to adults.
2 hours of activity.
<tr>Price: €30 / person.</tr>
<tr>Minimum 5 people</tr>

description: Are you a representative of a leisure center or a school, and would you like me to host a workshop?
I am at your disposal to send you a quote.
I offer a choice of pottery, costume jewelry, arts and crafts, and cooking workshops.
Feel free to contact me at 06 60 75 34 38 or by email, and we will choose a date and theme together.

Here are a few creations made in the schools and leisure center of Pignan, the schools of Fabrègues (Hérault) and St Siffret (Gard), the middle school of Fabrègues, the leisure center of Boirargues (34), Les Aiguerelles leisure center in Montpellier, and the MJC of Mauguio.
<tr>Pottery: tableware, family portrait frames, "cave painting" style plaques, garden decorations (multicolored poppies or owls)...</tr>
<tr>Arts and crafts: UV resin, flower pot painting, collages on notebooks...</tr>
<tr>Macramé, botanical frames, singing...</tr>
Feel free to ask for your personalized quote! I am at your service in the 34, 30, or 81 regions, at the dates and times that suit you best!

informations.title: Private lessons (adult/child)
description: You prefer learning through private lessons rather than participating in a group class.

Whether it is for costume jewelry, customizing a jacket, porcelain painting, tile painting, pottery, home decor, or flower pot painting... I am available to welcome you to my workshop or travel to your home.
My session will last 2.5 hours.
I will add a travel fee calculated based on the distance to be covered.
Travel expenses are free within Fabrègues.
The photos below are there to help you find an idea, but I am open to your creative suggestions too!
<tr>Price: €100, regardless of your chosen activity.</tr>

informations.title: Bachelorette party
description: I work in close collaboration with Maguelonne (le plaisir des 5 sens) to offer you an unforgettable afternoon or evening with your friends!

Massages, SPA sessions, creative crafts (pottery, mixed media, travel journals, jewelry...), cooking workshops, swimming pool: we will do everything possible to ensure this event leaves you with wonderful memories of relaxation, mindfulness, and friendship!
Since every bride-to-be is unique, we offer a customized review of your request.
Several packages are available, ranging from €60/person to €150/person.
We can travel to your home or welcome you to the beauty institute or my workshop.
Feel free to contact us for more information (pictured are a few ideas of possible projects: customizing your denim jacket, memory mosaic artwork, necklace, earrings, bracelets...).
See you soon!

informations.title: Workshops: over 2 days (without accommodation)
description: I offer arts and crafts, pottery, and costume jewelry workshops over 2 days - accommodation is at your own expense.

Subject to a minimum participation of 6 people, and under the framework of the THAADAM association, I offer workshops and well-being seminars on fixed dates, allowing you to recharge and reconnect through art.
Pottery, costume jewelry, singing, and arts and crafts will fill the two days we spend together.
Accommodation is not included in the price and is your responsibility.
However, lunch can be shared together (either a packed lunch brought by you or a meal prepared by me - price of €15).
Classes start at 10:00 AM until 12:30 PM, then resume at 2:00 PM until 5:30 PM.
The price depends on the activities defined in advance, but it generally runs around €400 per person.
This workshop takes place near Cournonterral (34) in a space dedicated to art.
Next date around June.

informations.title: Singing entertainment or Karaoke
description: Nursing homes, businesses, associations, individuals.
I invite you to let me liven up your evening or afternoon with songs!
Whether you are an individual, a company, or an association, I offer singing entertainment, tea dance style events, or karaokes.
Sliding scale pricing:
All music and song styles are available: disco, tango, paso doble, slow jams, waltzes, rock... Feel free to share your tastes, I adapt to your needs!
We can also sing as a group: custom pricing, fast quote.

Birthday gift, Christmas gift, friendship gift, bachelorette party, any amount is possible, and your voucher will be valid for 1 year from the day of purchase.
See you soon.
